title: 通过特征叠加几何理解涌现性失调
summary: 本文提出基于特征叠加几何的涌现性失调机制解释：微调放大目标特征时，会无意中增强邻近的有害特征。通过稀疏自编码器在多个LLM中验证，并展示几何感知过滤方法可降低34.5%失调。
summary_en: This paper proposes a geometric account for emergent misalignment based on feature superposition: fine-tuning that amplifies a target feature also unintentionally strengthens nearby harmful features. Validated in multiple LLMs, a geometry-aware filtering reduces misalignment by 34.5%.
